issues.label: Subject-matter jurisdiction divorce
issues.why: The court must confirm it has jurisdiction to grant a divorce and enter property/support orders.

issues.label: Personal jurisdiction over parties
issues.why: The court must have authority over both spouses to bind them with monetary and injunctive orders.

issues.label: Venue in Warren County
issues.why: Proper venue must exist for the domestic relations action to proceed there.

issues.label: Grounds for divorce proven
issues.why: The court must determine statutory grounds and evidentiary sufficiency to dissolve the marriage.

issues.label: Date of marriage and duration
issues.why: Marriage length affects property division equities and spousal support factors.

issues.label: Termination date of marriage
issues.why: Selecting the de facto termination date drives classification/valuation of assets and income.

issues.label: Separate vs marital property
issues.why: The court must classify each asset/debt as marital, separate, or mixed before division.

issues.label: Tracing and commingling
issues.why: If any asset is claimed separate, the court must trace sources and address commingling/transmutation.

issues.label: Valuation standard and method
issues.why: The court must choose legally acceptable valuation methods for each asset type.

issues.label: Valuation dates for assets
issues.why: The court must decide valuation dates (e.g., trial date vs separation) for each account/asset.

issues.label: Currency conversion methodology
issues.why: For Indian assets, the court must adopt an exchange-rate source/date and apply it consistently.

issues.label: Enforceability of foreign valuations
issues.why: The court must assess reliability/admissibility of JLL and Colliers reports under evidence rules.

issues.label: Expert credibility and weight
issues.why: The court must make implicit or explicit determinations on conflicting expert testimony.

issues.label: Marital debt classification
issues.why: The court must determine which liabilities are marital and allocate them equitably.

issues.label: SGV partner-maintenance debt
issues.why: The court must decide whether the claimed 87,472,943-rupee obligation is bona fide and how it reduces value.

issues.label: Allocation of contingent liabilities
issues.why: Any contingent business debts/guarantees must be valued/allocated or addressed by indemnity.

issues.label: Vora Ventures stipulated value
issues.why: The court must enforce or properly reject the $96M valuation stipulation and define its scope.

issues.label: Scope of stipulation binding
issues.why: The court must determine whether stipulation covers entity value only or also ownership and marital portion.

issues.label: Ownership interests after transfers
issues.why: The court must determine current equity percentages and whether they control for division.

issues.label: Validity of operating agreements
issues.why: The court must decide whether revised operating agreements were validly executed and effective.

issues.label: Spouse consent to transfers
issues.why: The court must assess whether Sangita knowingly and voluntarily consented to share transfers.

issues.label: Undue influence or coercion
issues.why: If alleged, the court must consider whether signatures were obtained through duress, fraud, or undue influence.

issues.label: Fraud in inducement claims
issues.why: The court must evaluate allegations she was misled about document nature/effect.

issues.label: Financial misconduct finding duty
issues.why: The court must decide whether to make explicit findings on alleged dissipation under R.C. 3105.171(E)(4).

issues.label: Dissipation/divorce planning
issues.why: The court must determine whether transfers were made to defeat marital rights and whether compensation is warranted.

issues.label: Intent and timing of gifts
issues.why: The court must resolve when transfers occurred and whether documentation is credible (e.g., gift tax returns vs undated papers).

issues.label: Characterization as charitable transfers
issues.why: The court must determine whether the transfers were true gifts/estate planning or improper asset shifting.

issues.label: Remedy without unwinding gifts
issues.why: The court must decide whether it can compensate via unequal division even if third-party ownership stands.

issues.label: Authority to affect third parties
issues.why: The court must consider limits on adjudicating daughters’/trusts’ rights without joinder.

issues.label: Necessary parties joinder
issues.why: If relief would impair daughters’/trusts’ interests, the court must consider joinder or limit relief.

issues.label: Jurisdiction over LLC structure
issues.why: The court must decide whether it can disregard or pierce the corporate/LLC structure for equitable division.

issues.label: Equitable division presumption
issues.why: The court must apply the equal-division presumption and justify any deviation with statutory factors.

issues.label: Marital portion of Vora Ventures
issues.why: The court must define what portion remains marital after transfers and how to divide it.

issues.label: Treatment of post-transfer appreciation
issues.why: The court must determine whether appreciation on transferred interests is excluded and whether any is marital due to misconduct.

issues.label: Business valuation vs liquidity
issues.why: The court must consider whether paper value and lack of cash affects payment mechanics and equity.

issues.label: Restrictions on asset transfers
issues.why: The court must decide propriety and scope of restraining orders to secure payment (e.g., Vora Ventures interest).

issues.label: HUF foreign-law notice adequacy
issues.why: Under Civ.R. 44.1, the court must confirm adequate notice and opportunity to be heard on Indian law.

issues.label: Determination of Indian law content
issues.why: The court must ascertain the relevant Indian law governing HUF creation and asset transfer mechanics.

issues.label: Proof of foreign law
issues.why: The court must decide what materials/testimony sufficiently prove foreign law and how to weigh experts.

issues.label: HUF creation validity
issues.why: The court must determine whether MV HUF was properly formed under Indian law.

issues.label: HUF asset-transfer requirements
issues.why: The court must decide what formalities (title change, declarations, registration) are required to transfer property into HUF.

issues.label: AnuPriya title vs declarations
issues.why: The court must resolve whether declarations alone transferred AnuPriya despite title remaining in Mahendra’s name.

issues.label: SGV share transfer to HUF
issues.why: The court must determine whether SGV shares were effectively assigned to the MV HUF in April 2018.

issues.label: Effect on marital classification
issues.why: The court must decide whether placing assets into HUF changes their status as marital property under Ohio law.

issues.label: Sangita’s interest in HUF
issues.why: The court must consider whether Sangita has any enforceable property interest as a “member” under Indian law.

issues.label: Control and revocability of HUF
issues.why: The court must consider whether Mahendra’s control as Karta makes HUF assets effectively reachable/equitable for division.

issues.label: Treatment of HUF as trust/entity
issues.why: The court must decide whether HUF should be treated like a trust, alter ego, or separate entity for equitable division.

issues.label: Bank of Baroda account ownership
issues.why: The court must determine whether the account is HUF property or marital property and value it accordingly.

issues.label: Double-counting HUF assets
issues.why: The court must ensure assets aren’t counted both as HUF and as individually owned in the marital estate.

issues.label: India real property division feasibility
issues.why: The court must consider practical enforceability of orders affecting Indian real estate and craft remedies accordingly.

issues.label: AnuPriya marital nature undisputed
issues.why: Given stipulation it was built with marital funds, the court must still classify and divide it and set valuation.

issues.label: AnuPriya valuation choice
issues.why: The court must decide between JLL and Colliers valuations and explain basis sufficiently for review.

issues.label: SGV interest valuation choice
issues.why: The court must choose between JLL and Colliers valuations and handle discounts/premiums appropriate to a 15% interest.

issues.label: Minority/marketability discounts
issues.why: The court must decide whether to apply any discounts to Mahendra’s 15% SGV stake and Vora Ventures interest.

issues.label: Tax consequences of division
issues.why: The court must consider tax impacts of transfers, gifts, trust assignments, and any liquidation/sale to fund payments.

issues.label: Gift-tax return implications
issues.why: The court must consider whether gift-tax filings corroborate timing/validity of transfers and the parties’ intent.

issues.label: Post-decree enforcement tools
issues.why: The court must determine mechanisms (security, liens, QDRO-like orders, injunctions) to ensure payment.

issues.label: Installment payment plan equity
issues.why: The court must decide whether paying $18.3M over 10 years is equitable given asset values, incomes, and risk.

issues.label: Interest rate and accrual
issues.why: The court must decide whether interest is required, at what rate, and from what date to avoid unjust enrichment.

issues.label: Statutory interest authority
issues.why: The court must ground any interest/no-interest decision in applicable Ohio statutes/rules and equitable powers.

issues.label: Security for deferred payments
issues.why: The court must consider requiring collateral, guarantees, or restrictions to protect Sangita from nonpayment.

issues.label: Acceleration upon sale events
issues.why: The court must decide how sale proceeds of Vora Ventures companies affect the schedule and whether such provisions are clear/enforceable.

issues.label: Risk allocation of business downturn
issues.why: The court must decide who bears risk if Vora Ventures value/cash flow declines during installment period.

issues.label: Clarity and definiteness of decree
issues.why: The decree must be sufficiently specific on amounts, dates, exchange rates, and procedures to be enforceable.

issues.label: Goldman Sachs account valuation date
issues.why: The court must determine the correct valuation date and handle market fluctuations for those accounts.

issues.label: Agreement on conversion formula
issues.why: The court must decide whether the parties actually agreed to a rupee-dollar conversion formula and incorporate it correctly.

issues.label: Spousal support eligibility
issues.why: The court must determine whether support is appropriate despite large property awards.

issues.label: R.C. 3105.18 factor findings
issues.why: The court must consider and reflect the statutory factors, including income, earning ability, duration, and standard of living.

issues.label: Imputation of income
issues.why: The court must decide whether to impute income to Sangita or adjust for Mahendra’s control over business salary/distributions.

issues.label: Ability to pay support
issues.why: The court must evaluate Mahendra’s true ability to pay given business cash flow, debt service, and assets.

issues.label: Support amount and duration
issues.why: The court must determine the proper amount, start date, and any termination conditions.

issues.label: Support tax treatment
issues.why: The court must account for current federal/state tax rules on alimony when assessing net effects.

issues.label: Support vs property division interaction
issues.why: The court must ensure support does not improperly substitute for or duplicate property division outcomes.

issues.label: Attorney fees consideration
issues.why: The court must address any statutory/equitable basis for awarding fees and the parties’ relative ability to pay, if requested.

issues.label: Standard of proof allocation
issues.why: The court must apply correct burdens (e.g., financial misconduct, separate property, foreign-law assertions).

issues.label: Evidentiary admissibility issues
issues.why: The court must rule on authentication/translation of foreign documents, business records, and expert foundations.

issues.label: Due process and notice
issues.why: The court must ensure each party had fair notice/opportunity to respond, especially on foreign-law and post-trial decree language.

issues.label: Appellate review preservation
issues.why: The court must enter findings sufficient to permit meaningful appellate review on contested valuation/misconduct issues.

issues.label: Equity regarding nonworking spouse
issues.why: The court must consider Sangita’s homemaker contributions and foregone career opportunities in division/support.

issues.label: Post-separation transactions
issues.why: The court must evaluate transactions after separation for classification, misconduct, and valuation effects.

issues.label: Final decree conformity to decisions
issues.why: The court must ensure the final decree accurately incorporates prior partial decisions without inconsistency.
